lead.headline: COP31 races to save the climate deal
lead.summary: A new draft deal emerged in Turkey as the COP31 talks ran into a second day of overtime, with a fossil-fuel dispute threatening to collapse the negotiations.

stories.headline: Indonesia factory fire: 3 dead, 36 missing
stories.summary: A blaze at a confectionery factory near Jakarta left three dead and dozens unaccounted for.

stories.headline: NATO vows to defend 'every inch' of Poland
stories.summary: The alliance answered a Russian airspace violation with a firm pledge to defend Polish territory.

stories.headline: Nigeria boat capsizes: at least 24 dead
stories.summary: A boat carrying people to a funeral overturned in Nigeria, killing at least 24.

stories.headline: UN court: Myanmar guilty of Rohingya genocide
stories.summary: The top UN court ruled Myanmar guilty of genocide against Rohingya Muslims.
